query: SELECT pc.id, pc.userId, pc.componentId, pc.status, pc.componentRole, u.name as userName, u.email as userEmail, c.code as compCode, c.name as compName FROM professor_components pc JOIN users u ON pc.userId = u.id JOIN components c ON pc.componentId = c.id WHERE pc.status = 'pending' LIMIT 10
